why: The curl project received an AI-written report whose GitHub link began with an Armenian letter in place of the g. The fail side is a README with that link. The pass side holds the honest non-ASCII a repository carries: the same link in ASCII, a Portuguese accented path segment, a Japanese path segment on a Latin host, and a resistance written with the Greek omega in prose, which is never judged. Judge prose, or treat any non-ASCII as mixed, and the pass side goes red; judge only the path and the fail side goes green.
